settings.title: Group Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.currencyChangeWarning: Changing currency only affects future expenses. Existing expenses will keep their original conversion rates.
settings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.

settings.addMemberDescription: Add someone to the group who doesn't have an account yet. They can be assigned expenses and will show up in splits. If they sign up later, their data can be merged into their real account.
settings.archiveDescription: Archive this group to hide it from your dashboard. Everyone must be settled up first. You can unarchive it at any time.
settings.archiveConfirm: Archive this group? It will be hidden from your dashboard.
settings.deleteDescription: Deleting a group removes all expenses, settlements, and member data permanently.

settle.title: Record a payment
settle.description: Record a payment between two group members.
settle.samePerson: From and To must be different people.

invite.title: Invite to group
invite.description: Generate an invite link to share with friends. Links expire after 7 days.
invite.linkInfo: Anyone with this link can join the group.
invite.claimDescription: When {name} accepts this link, the expenses and payments recorded for them become theirs. Links expire after 7 days.
invite.claimLinkInfo: Send this only to {name}: whoever accepts it first takes over their expenses and payments.

merge.title: Merge {name} into a member
merge.description: If {name} already joined this group with an account, move everything recorded for {name} to that account.
merge.confirm: {name}'s expenses, shares and payments will move to {member}, and {name} will be removed from the group. This can't be undone.
